\subsection*{The statements of record}

\axstatement{F:bool-and-comm}{Boolean conjunction is commutative}
For all Booleans x and y, x \&\& y equals y \&\& x.\par
\par\noindent\small Language \texttt{lean4}:
\begin{verbatim}
((x : Bool) -> ((y : Bool) -> Eq.{1} Bool (Bool.and x y) (Bool.and y x)))
\end{verbatim}

\par\noindent Proof route: \texttt{imported-kernel-lean}.\par

\par\noindent Depends on: nothing (foundational).\par
